subject: Request: marketplace trial top-up for Finity POC — partner supplement
messages:
From: Elena Costa <partners@cloudstacklabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Additional Marketplace Trial Top-up for Finity POC

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well — quick ask on behalf of Finity (the accelerator cohort we co-run). The POC with Finity portfolio company NovaLedger is hitting a token/compute spike after their prompt expansion. The current marketplace promo exhausted earlier than expected.

Can CloudStack and Redwood coordinate a +$8,000 top-up to the marketplace voucher so NovaLedger can continue the POC through the end of September? Finity is willing to match $4k and CloudStack is asking Redwood for the remaining $4k as a partner supplement.

We can share a short usage export and the PoC objectives (latency and cost benchmarks) if that helps expedite approval. We’d like a quick decision to avoid service disruption tomorrow during a live demo.

Attachments: none (I will follow up with a usage zip).

Best,
Elena Costa
Partnerships, CloudStack Labs
partners@cloudstacklabs.com


From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Costa <partners@cloudstacklabs.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Additional Marketplace Trial Top-up for Finity POC

Thanks Elena — looping in Jordan and Ben from Partner Ops so we can triage quickly.

Two quick asks to speed this along:
- Can you send the usage extract (last 30 days) and a short note on expected additional token consumption?
- Confirm whether Finity will sign a short addendum for the co-funded top-up (we typically require a quick acceptance to track promo accounting).

If we get the usage file and confirm the $4k match from Finity, I’ll route to Growth for expedited approval. We’ll aim to avoid any interruption for the demo.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Elena Costa <partners@cloudstacklabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-21T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Additional Marketplace Trial Top-up for Finity POC

Kimberly, Jordan — attached is the usage export and a short summary (finity_usage_report_aug.zip). Key points:
- NovaLedger used 3.2M tokens in the past 14 days due to expanded evaluation prompts.
- Predicted extra need: ~1.1–1.4M tokens through 2028-09-30 (~$8k retail on promo terms).
- Finity confirms they will commit $4k immediately (see quick confirmation below).

Finity confirmation (copied):
> From: grants@finityaccelerator.org
> Re: match confirm — Finity confirms $4k co-fund for NovaLedger through Sep 30.

We can sign a short addendum. Please advise next steps and any required PO or Docusign link for the partner supplement.

Thanks,
Elena

Attachments: finity_usage_report_aug.zip (CSV + summary)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-22T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Additional Marketplace Trial Top-up for Finity POC

Thanks for the data — looks reasonable for a one-time supplement given the demo timing. A couple of operational checks before I ask Growth to approve:
1) Confirm accounting code for partner-sponsored vouchers (we’ll route under Q3 partnership budget).
2) We need an addendum template — legal can sign a two-paragraph statement that the partner credits are promotional and expire 2028-09-30.
3) Any security/compliance concerns? Does NovaLedger handle PII in the workload? If yes, we should note any data handling restrictions on the trial.

Jordan/Ben: can you confirm the accounting code and confirm we can issue $4k promo on the marketplace ledger (partner-supplement line)? If so I’ll escalate to Marissa for sign-off.

- Soojin
Soojín Lee
Head of Channel Programs | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-22T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: one-time partner supplement for NovaLedger (conditions)

Approved — authorize a $4,000 Redwood supplement to pair with Finity’s $4,000 match, subject to the following conditions:
- Addendum must be executed by CloudStack and Finity accepting terms that credits expire 2028-09-30 and are non-refundable.
- NovaLedger confirms no PII is present in the test set; if there is, we need a short data handling note and an SSO requirement for demo sessions.
- Finance to post charge to Q3 Partner Promo (acct: PP-23-07).

Jordan/Ben: please prepare the marketplace voucher top-up and provide a quick Ops runbook so we can avoid downtime for their demo tomorrow. Kim — please send the addendum link to CloudStack and loop back when signed.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, Growth Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Costa <partners@cloudstacklabs.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-08-24T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Additional Marketplace Trial Top-up for Finity POC

Elena — good news: Growth has approved a $4k Redwood supplement to pair with Finity’s $4k match. I’ve created the small addendum and uploaded it to DocuSign here: https://docusign.example/sign/ABCD1234 (please sign by EOD to activate).

Next steps for CloudStack/NovaLedger:
- Sign the DocuSign addendum (link above).
- Confirm NovaLedger does not process PII in the demo datasets. If they do, tell us how they’ll mask/obfuscate.

Ops note (Jordan): once signed we’ll apply a $8,000 top-up to the marketplace voucher pool and notify Finity/CloudStack. Jordan will share the voucher id and quick runbook.

Attachments: signed_topup_agreement.pdf (to be attached after DocuSign completes)

Thanks everyone — Kim
Kimberly Park
Partner Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
